column2: (1) The Council shall cancel the registration of an

column1: engineering practitioner, if the Council is satisfied that such

column2: has contravened any of the provisions of this Act or
any  regulation  made  thereunder  or  any  term  and
has been adjudged by a competent court whether
in or outside Sri Lanka to be of unsound mind;
has been found guilty of professional misconduct
after an inquiry held by the Council; or
has been convicted  for an offence under this Act.
